# Performalytic

> Data-Driven Growth for Your Business. Performalytic is an enterprise data analytics, AI, and DevOps consulting firm that helps organizations turn data into a competitive advantage. Headquartered in Chicago, IL with a global delivery center in Bhubaneswar, India. Trusted by 500+ enterprise clients with 800+ data professionals and 99.9% client satisfaction.

## Services
- [Enterprise Solution Development](/enterprise-solution-development/): Data strategy, architecture, master data management, governance, and platform modernization
- [Advanced Analytics & AI](/advanced-analytics-ai/): Machine learning, generative AI, RAG systems, AI agents, predictive analytics, and responsible AI
- [BI Integration](/bi-integration/): Business intelligence implementation on Power BI, SAP, Snowflake, Databricks, and Microsoft Fabric
- [Application Development & System Integration](/application-development-and-system-integration/): Custom application development, CI/CD automation, and system integration

## Solutions
- AI-Powered MDM & Entity Resolution
- Automated Data Reconciliation
- Data Quality & Observability
- CI/CD Pipeline Automation
- Schema Compare & Version Control
- Entity Relationship Modeling

## Products & Tools
- [4DAlert](/products/): AI-powered data management platform
- [Data ROI Calculator](/tools/data-roi-calculator/): Free interactive tool to estimate savings from better data
- [All Tools](/tools/): Calculators and assessments
